Implemented the complete C++20 RS274 simulator in [`output/`](/workspace/output):

- [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt)
- [simulator.cpp](/workspace/output/simulator.cpp)
- [simulator.hpp](/workspace/output/simulator.hpp)
- [main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp)

It supports the required CLI, tool/parameter files, probing, block deletion, modal execution, canned cycles, cutter/tool compensation, all trace modes, JSON deltas, and error exits.

Verified with clean release and sanitizer builds, the supplied trace examples, and the specification’s Appendix C programs.

Build from `output/`:

```bash
cmake -B build && cmake --build build
```
